# [object Object]

> Engineering calculators that end in a number you can quote.

- [Carton Blank & Sheet Yield](https://calc.getoolkit.com/carton-blank-yield/): RSC blank size, boxes per sheet, board cost per box.
- [Pallet Carton Fit](https://calc.getoolkit.com/pallet-carton-fit/): Cartons per layer, layers per pallet, landed cost per carton.
- [Acrylic Panel Quote](https://calc.getoolkit.com/acrylic-panel-quote/): Pieces per sheet, material and cut cost, ready-to-send price.
- [Glass Sheet Yield](https://calc.getoolkit.com/glass-sheet-yield/): Cuts per jumbo sheet, utilization, glass cost per piece.
- [Container Load Fit](https://calc.getoolkit.com/container-load-fit/): Cartons per container, cube used, freight per carton.
- [Tile Quantity Calculator](https://calc.getoolkit.com/tile-quantity-calc/): Whole tiles, boxes to order, total cost with adhesive.
- [Concrete Volume & Mix Cost](https://calc.getoolkit.com/concrete-slab-mix/): m³ needed, cement bags, ready-mix vs site-mix cost.
- [Paint Coverage & Cost](https://calc.getoolkit.com/paint-wall-coverage/): Wall area, litres of paint, buckets to buy, cost per m².
- [Sheet Metal Nesting](https://calc.getoolkit.com/sheet-metal-nesting/): Parts per sheet, utilization, material + laser cost per part.
- [Air Chargeable Weight](https://calc.getoolkit.com/air-chargeable-weight/): Volumetric vs actual weight, chargeable kg, freight cost.
- [Cable Voltage Drop](https://calc.getoolkit.com/cable-voltage-drop/): Current, volt drop, % drop, minimum standard cross-section.
- [Asphalt Tonnage & Cost](https://calc.getoolkit.com/asphalt-tonnage/): Tonnes to order, mix cost, paving cost, ¥ per m².
